scenario: JSON introspection per LEXP.6 — has() checks whether a JSON key is present at runtime. Rule fires only when the key exists in the JSON slot value. body slot receives a Python dict (JSON object) so the stored CLIPS string is a parseable JSON object.
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    body: Json key

rule r_has_key:
    Payload p where has(p.body.temperature)
->
    log critical "has_temp"

rule r_no_key:
    Payload p where has(p.body.humidity)
->
    log critical "has_humid"
